title: Contractor Onboarding Specialist
description:
Saving the World! Help Wanted…

Budderfly is a fast-growth, private equity-backed energy management outsourcing company that is committed to reducing global carbon emissions for small to medium sized enterprises. We are the premier sustainability partner for businesses with repeatable footprints such as restaurant chains, assisted living facilities, retail franchises, and more. Budderfly installs, monitors, and manages a combination of patented technologies, equipment upgrades, and proprietary energy software to help deliver complete energy saving solutions for our customers.

Celebrating 5 years on Inc. 5000 America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies list. Recognized in Time Magazine’s Best Inventions of 2025.

We are an energetic and dedicated team working together to make a positive impact on the environment while providing an excellent customer experience. We are growing quickly and looking to add talented people who are passionate about making the world a better place!

We have an opportunity for a motivated individual to fill the role of Contractor Onboarding Specialist. In this position, the successful candidate will be responsible for managing our referred contractor pipeline and assisting in the training and onboarding of approved contractors.
Why this Role is Important:
Budderfly ’s continued success is directly related to the strength and quality of our national contractor network. As part of our continued commitment to customer satisfaction, Budderfly encourages customers to recommend their preferred contractors for inclusion in our network. The Contractor Onboarding Specialist role will focus on onboarding and training both customer-referred and nationally recognized contractors, actively growing our network of approved contractors while improving our customer satisfaction and time-to-install metrics. This role reports to the Senior Business Development Manager on the Contractor Relations Team.
Responsibilities:

• Contractor Pipeline Management: Manage Budderfly 's referred contractor pipeline, evaluating prospective contractors and determining whether they advance through the onboarding process based on established business, operational, legal, and compliance requirements.

• Onboarding Process Management: Own, oversee, and continuously improve the contractor onboarding process, ensuring a smooth transition from recruitment through activation while identifying and implementing process improvements to improve contractor quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

• Training and Orientation: Coordinate contractor onboarding and training activities with the Program Manager, Contractor Training, ensuring contractors successfully complete onboarding requirements and are prepared to perform work on behalf of Budderfly .

• Communication and Coordination: Serve as the primary point of contact for contractors throughout the onboarding process, resolving onboarding issues, coordinating with internal departments, and ensuring timely progression through the onboarding pipeline.

• System Integration: Manage contractor onboarding into required systems, platforms, and tools (HubSpot, FastFields, InJobs, Sitetracker), ensuring contractors meet all operational requirements prior to activation.

• Reporting & Business Analysis: Analyze onboarding metrics, contractor pipeline activity, training effectiveness, contractor feedback, and onboarding timelines to identify trends, recommend operational improvements, and report program performance to leadership.

• Pricing & Contract Administration: Negotiate contractor pricing and contractual terms within established business guidelines and coordinate with Contractor Relations leadership on exceptions or unique business circumstances.

• Continuous Improvement: Develop, refine, and implement contractor onboarding procedures, documentation, and best practices to improve contractor readiness, operational efficiency, and the overall onboarding experience.

title: Senior FinOps Analyst
description:
Responsibilities
Peraton is seeking a Cloud FinOps Analyst to manage cloud financial operations for a large, multi-tenant AWS environment spanning both commercial and GovCloud accounts. This role is responsible for improving cost visibility, accountability, and optimization across the organization.
The analyst will turn cloud usage and spending data into actionable insights for engineering and business teams, identifying opportunities to reduce costs while maintaining system performance, reliability, and availability. The FinOps Analyst will also provide consolidated cloud cost reporting and forecasting to leadership, finance, and engineering teams. Responsibilities include tracking monthly actuals, analyzing spending trends, managing chargeback and cost allocation, and developing fiscal-year cost projections.
This role works closely with finance, engineering, platform, and program teams to establish consistent FinOps practices and integrate cost management into the software development lifecycle. The goal is to make cloud costs transparent, predictable, and actionable so teams can make informed decisions about how they build and operate AWS services.
Location: Remote
Shift Schedule: 8am - 5pm Eastern Standard Time (EST)
What you will do:
Cost Optimization and Resource Right-Sizing

• Analyze utilization data from AWS Cost Explorer, Compute Optimizer, Trusted Advisor, and CloudWatch to identify right-sizing opportunities across EC2, RDS, EBS, ELB, and container workloads.

• Develop prioritized right-sizing recommendations with quantified savings, and partner with engineering owners to implement and validate those recommendations rather than simply delivering a report.

• Identify idle, orphaned, and overprovisioned resources, and coordinate recurring remediation with the appropriate engineering and platform teams.

• Manage Reserved Instance and Savings Plan strategy, including coverage analysis, purchase recommendations, utilization monitoring, and lifecycle management.

• Reduce storage costs through S3 lifecycle policies, appropriate EBS volume types, intelligent tiering, and effective snapshot management.

• Establish a continuous optimization process that incorporates cost efficiency into day-to-day cloud operations rather than addressing it only after costs increase.

Consolidated Cost Reporting and Analysis

• Build and maintain consolidated monthly cost reports covering AWS spend, usage trends, unit economics, and optimization opportunities across accounts, business units, and programs.

• Design and manage chargeback and showback models that allocate cloud costs to the appropriate business units with clear, transparent, and defensible cost attribution.

• Implement and enforce a consistent cost-allocation tagging strategy across the AWS estate, and drive remediation of untagged or incorrectly tagged resources.

• Develop executive dashboards and program-level scorecards using AWS Cost and Usage Reports to provide clear visibility into cloud spending and performance.

• Perform root-cause analysis on cost anomalies and unexpected spending variances, and communicate findings and recommended actions clearly to both finance and engineering audiences.

• Support cost governance and reporting across a multi-account AWS Organizations environment spanning commercial and GovCloud accounts under consolidated billing.

Forecasting and Budget Management

• Develop fiscal-year cloud spend projections and monthly burn-rate views, and update forecasts as consumption, program scope, and pricing change.

• Model the expected cost impact of architectural changes, migrations, and new workload onboarding before financial or engineering commitments are made.

• Monitor budget utilization against plan, identify variances early, and recommend corrective actions to keep programs on track.

• Support annual budgeting, quarterly reforecasts, and business-case development for cloud investments.

• Configure and manage AWS Budgets and Cost Anom

We are seeking a Senior Data Governance Analyst who will play an integral role in the execution of the banks enterprise data governance framework and supports the Senior Manager Analytics and Governance who has primary responsibility for enterprise-wide data governance activities.
The incumbent is responsible for monitoring and maintaining a robust data governance environment primarily through data risk assessments and ensuring the timely assignment and remediation of data incidents. • Administers the Enterprise Data Governance programme by creating processes in support of data management practices to ensure compliance with the banks data governance and management policies.

• Reviews data management practices in collaboration with the Senior Manager to ensure that the business is both aware of developments and operates within the Governance framework. This will include making recommendations to the Senior Manager on any updates that are required to processes, policies or business activities.

• Analyze the effectiveness of data management processes and procedures in Technology and lines of businesses to identify and close gaps and reduce material data risks.

• Conducts in depth monitoring of adherence data management processes to ensure compliance with regulatory authorities and data management standards.

• Develops and maintains key effective relationships with unit leaders, data owners, data stewards and data custodians ensuring that there is clarity and consistency in methodology and practices for data management and governance throughout and across the business units.

• Assists the Senior Manager and accountable officers in assessing data risks arising from all projects, products and change initiatives impacting the Line of Businesses (LOB) to ensure that material risks are appropriately identified and mitigated.

• Provides support to data owners and stewards responsible for resolving data incidents under their purview and developing achievable action plans with realistic due dates to ensure that data incidents are remediated within agreed timeframe.

• Monitors and tracks Data Incidents by attending weekly or monthly meetings (data quality working group etc.) to ensure that action plan owners are executing remedial actions as scheduled thereby minimising exposure.

Requirements:

• 7 10 years banking experience, with a proven background in governance and control functions inclusive of the KCARs, SOX and quarterly assertion processes.

• Understanding of banking data environment.

• Knowledge of data governance practices, business and technology issues related to management of enterprise information assets and approaches related to data management.

• Demonstrated consulting skills, with change management concepts and strategies, including communication, culture change and performance measurement design.

• Experience in risk management, control testing, remediation management and reporting.

• In-depth understanding of process improvement, risk, control and deficiency management to provide leadership to the business units.

• Good understanding of end-to-end banking process flows to be able to develop controls in the context of new process development and providing a good basis for identifying risk and the absence of control.

description:

If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda into their own systems. You'll be part of a greenfield team building a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption entirely from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, responsible not only for the streaming architecture itself, but also the analytics product and other data consumers built on top of it - with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures. You will play a key part in shaping the architecture in a genuinely exciting and fast-paced domain.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk https://www.camundacon.com/event-session/camundacon-amsterdam-2025/one-exporter-to-rule-them-all-exploring-camunda-exporter/?on_demand=true from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

- Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, low-cost storage.

- Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

- Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

- Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

- Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product. 

What You Bring:

- Ability and/or willingness to use our product https://accounts.cloud.camunda.io/signup?_ga=2.47330343.12755

title: Senior Staff Data Engineer

Why Mozilla ?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission - to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Mozilla ’s Data Engineering team is looking for a Senior Staff Data Engineer / Data Platform Engineer to help build the present and future of our Data Platform infrastructure. This role will be a hybrid Data Engineer / Data Platform Engineer, working across both teams (Data Platform Engineering and Data Engineering) in a technical leadership capacity.

Mozilla ’s Data Platform serves the needs of multiple products, including the Firefox browser, from data collection through to insights, product experiences, and machine learning applications.

Our goal is to build a robust, efficient, and effective platform that makes it increasingly easy to inform Mozilla ’s business and product decisions. For more details, please take a look at the overview or the Data@ Mozilla blog.

What you’ll do:

• Design, build, and improve systems to reliably and efficiently process data at the scale of tens of terabytes per day, and apply those systems to solve meaningful problems for the business.

• Evaluate new technologies. Work with Data Engineering and Data Platform Engineering not only to implement these technologies but also to set best-practice standards.

• Craft and improve workflows in GCP using standard, modern components such as Dataflow, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, GKE, and Airflow.

• Drive cross-functional projects with stakeholders across Mozilla , including Data Science, Product, Legal, Policy, and Engineering.

• Mentor teammates and develop engineering best practices across the Data Organization.

• Work with Data Science to design and implement useful data abstractions.

• Address the evolving needs of active Data Products.

What you’ll bring:

• 10+ years of combined experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Data Science, or Data Analyst roles

• Deep expertise in Data Engineering and Data Platform Engineering.

• Experience with data tooling in GCP, AWS, or Azure, including Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and Dataflow (Apache Beam), or similar technologies.

• Experience with Looker, Fivetran, Kubernetes / GKE, Airflow / Cloud Composer, and Terraform, or similar technologies.

• Advanced coding skills in SQL and Python.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals: modularity, abstraction, data structures, and algorithms.

• Experience as a tech lead, team lead, hands-on Data Engineering or Data Platform manager, or similar leadership role.

• Commitment to our values:

• Welcoming differences

• Being relationship-minded

• Practicing responsible participation

• Having grit

What you’ll get:

• Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team

• Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage

title: Senior Software Engineer, Mapping Data & Eval
locationText: San Francisco, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Roadgraph team builds the intelligent platform and automated pipelines that create, validate, and scale the high-definition geo knowledge base powering the Waymo Driver. We combine applied machine learning, computer vision, statistical evaluation, and large-scale distributed systems to solve one of the most foundational and exciting challenges in autonomous driving.

High-definition mapping is a foundational pillar enabling the Waymo Driver to navigate safely, smoothly, and reliably. To rapidly expand commercial autonomous ride-hailing to new cities and continents, we must scale our automated mapping pipelines. This role sits at the center of that mission-building the applied ML models, evaluation engines, and large-scale data infrastructure that transform real-world sensor streams into the world's most precise and reliable spatial knowledge base.

We work closely with onboard engineers to solve problems in an end to end fashion. You will be working on all aspects of the modeling life cycle (labeling, training, evaluation, inference), put your models to work, and measure impact on the overall system.

You will:

• Evaluate and launch machine learning models that automatically generate map from raw data.

• Work with onboard teams to evolve Waymo’s mapping format to make it more automation friendly.

• Apply statistical analysis to validate large-scale changes.

• Build backend infrastructure for storing and processing many forms of map data.

• Scale our systems to support mapping the whole world.

You have:

• B.S. in Computer Science or a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Hands-on experience with statistical analysis, experiment design, and quantitative evaluation of ML models or data pipelines.

• Experience building scalable data processing pipelines using distributed frameworks like Google Data Flow or Apache Beam.

• Demonstrated ability to take ownership of complex technical problems end-to-end and deliver measurable results in a collaborative team environment.

• A passion for good software engineering.

We prefer:

• Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, Computer Vision, or a related quantitative field.

title: Senior Engineer - Front End
description:
Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.

That’s why we created what3words . We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

Who we’re looking for

Based in Vietnam out of our centrally located Ho Chi Minh City office, we’re looking for an experienced Front End Engineer who knows code, and enjoys creating engaging experiences that people love to use.

At what3words , we're proud of our tech stack. We have built a massively scalable, microservices-based architecture, based around Kubernetes on AWS. You'll be exposed to technologies such as ReactJS, Docker, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS Lambdas, Prometheus, Grafana, Python, Athena, BigQuery, Java, Scala, C++, and Swift.

This is a great opportunity to join a collaborative, ambitious and Agile team, at one of the most exciting times in this company's life.

Requirements:
This role will focus primarily on the development of our map site, account management system, and other websites to support and showcase what3words ’ offerings. You will also work closely with our product and UX teams, receiving and inputting on designs and feasibility checks, and bringing fresh ideas to make what3words a better solution. You will have good experience of building sleek user interfaces on top of RESTful web APIs, using React, JavaScript, CSS. You will be able to work independently, self-motivate, collaborate well with others and keep calm under pressure.
What we expect:

• Strong experience with ES6, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS.

• Excellent communication skills in verbal and written English.

• A passion for software engineering and continuous learning.

• Solid track record of building responsive sites for desktop, tablet and mobile.

Bonus points for:

• Knowledge of Next.js, Google Maps or Leaflet, GIS systems, AWS, Kubernetes, or similar systems.

• Experience of Agile working environments.

The role is based in our centrally located HCMC office . While you can work from the office five days a week if preferred, our Engineering team can choose to work up to two days a week from home. We also offer a six-week remote-work allowance; for up to six weeks a year, you can work from anywhere in the world (as long as you’ve got great WiFi and are happy to work with your main office timezone).

Equality, diversity and inclusion at what3words

Our mission is to help everyone talk about everywhere, and we believe diverse perspectives make for a better company and better products too. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented groups and are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our hiring processes and company culture.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits to all permanent employees of what3words :

• Share options

The Applied team works across research, engineering, product, and design to bring OpenAI’s technology to the world. We seek to learn from deployment and broadly distribute the benefits of AI, while ensuring that this powerful tool is used responsibly and safely. We aim to make our innovative tools globally accessible, transcending geographic, economic, or platform barriers. Our commitment is to facilitate the use of AI to enhance lives, fostered by rigorous insights into how people use our products.

 

About the Role

We are seeking Software Engineers (Emerging Talent) to join our Applied Engineering team. You’ll work in a highly iterative, collaborative, fast-paced environment to bring our technology to millions of users around the world, and ensure it’s delivered with safety and reliability in mind. We value engineers who are self-starters, care deeply about the end user experience, and take pride in building products to solve customer needs.

 

In this role, you will:

- Own the development of new customer-facing ChatGPT and OpenAI API features and product experiences end-to-end

- Talk to users to understand their problems and design solutions to address them

- Collaborate with a cross-functional team of engineers, researchers, product managers, designers, and operations folks to create cutting-edge products

- Optimize applications for speed and scale

- Create a diverse and inclusive culture that makes all feel welcome.

 

Your background looks something like:

- Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience

- 0-1 years of experience in software engineering or a relevant field

- Proficiency with JavaScript, React, and some backend languages (we use Python)

- Some experience with relational databases like Postgres/MySQL

- Interest in AI/ML (direct experience not required)

- Ability to move fast in an environment where things are sometimes loosely defined and may have competing priorities or deadlines

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

description:
ABOUT BEACON AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking skilled Cloud and ML Infrastructure Engineers to lead the buildout of our AWS foundation and our LLM platform. You will design, implement, and operate services that are scalable, reliable, and secure.

The broad scope means focus areas in LLM/ML Infra and IoT infra are strong bonus points. For ML Infra, build the stack that powers retrieval-augmented generation and application workflows built with frameworks like LangChain. Experience with IoT AWS services is a plus.

You will work closely with other engineers and product management. The ideal candidate is hands-on, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to build from first principles.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Cloud Infrastructure Setup and Maintenance

- Design, provision, and maintain AWS infrastructure using IaC tools such as AWS CDK or Terraform.

- Build CI/CD and testing for apps, infra, and ML pipelines using GitHub Actions, CodeBuild, and CodePipeline.

- Operate secure networking with VPCs, PrivateLink, and VPC endpoints. Manage IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, and audit logging.

- LLM Platform and Runtime

- Stand up and operate model endpoints using AWS Bedrock and/or SageMaker; evaluate when to use ECS/EKS, Lambda, or Batch for inference jobs.

- Build and maintain application services that call LLMs through clean APIs, with streaming, batching, and backoff strategies.

- Implement prompt and tool execution flows with LangChain or similar, including agent tools and function calling.

- RAG Data Systems and Vector Search

- Design chunking and embedding pipelines for documents, time series, and multimedia. Orchestrate with Step Functions or Airflow.

- Operate vector search using OpenSearch Serverless, Aurora PostgreSQL with pgvector, or Pinecone. Tune recall, latency, and cost.

- Build and maintain knowledge bases and data syncs from S3, Aurora, DynamoDB, and external sources.

- Evaluation, Observability, and Cost Governance

- Create offline and online eval harnesses for prompts, retrievers, and chains. Track quality, latency, and regression risk.

- Instrument model and app telemetry with CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry. Build token usage and cost dashboards with budgets and alerts.

- Add guardrails, rate limits, fallbacks, and provider routing for resilience.

- Safety, Privacy, and Compliance

- Implement PII detection and redaction, access controls, content filters, and human-in-the-loop review where needed.

- Use Bedrock Guardrails or policy services to enforce safety standards. Maintain audit trails for regulated environments.

- Data Pipeline Construction

- Build ingestion and processing pipelines for structured, unstructured, and multimedia data. Ensure integrity, lineage, and cataloging with Glue and Lake Formation.

- Optimize bulk data movement and storage in S3, Glacier, and tiered storage. Use Athena for ad-hoc analysis.

- IoT Deployment Management

- Manage infrastructure that deploys to and communicates with edge devices. Support secure messaging, identity, and over-the-air updates.

- Analytics and Application Support

- Partner with product and application teams to integrate retrieval services, embeddings, and LLM chains into user-facing features.

- Provide expert troubleshooting for cloud and ML services with an emphasis on uptime and performance.

- Performance Optimization

- Tune retrieval quality, context window use, and caching with Redis or Bedrock Knowledge Bases.

- Optimize inference with model selection, quantization

description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About this role

Okta Secures AI is Okta's product line for agent identity: securing what AI agents can access and do across the enterprise. This team owns the category narrative, direct customer engagement, field enablement, deal-process improvement, and market presence, all in service of one number: pipe-to-revenue conversion.

This is a field-facing role. You'll spend most of your time alongside sellers and account teams, in front of customers and prospects, helping move specific deals forward. You'll also carry ownership of how the sales process itself works: running win rooms, building the sales-play motions that move deals through the pipeline, and pushing ideas that accelerate conversion. What you hear in the field feeds directly back into how the team positions and messages Okta Secures AI, and you'll shape that narrative as much as you support the deals it's used in.

What you'll do

• Get in front of customers and prospects directly and often, working alongside sellers and account teams on live deal pursuits, of all audience sizes, from a single stakeholder to a room of buyers.

• Travel to speak at in-person events, representing Okta Secures AI to customers and partners, and sharpening the narrative based on what lands.

• Run win rooms and build the sales-play motions that move Okta Secures AI deals through the pipeline, then track how well they convert.

• Own pitch decks and one-pagers for live deals and events, making sure the positioning holds up in front of real buyers, not just on paper.

• Turn recurring deal friction into reusable fixes: a sharper play, a new asset, a messaging shift, or a process change that helps sellers move the next deal faster, not just this one.

• Earn a standing seat at QBRs and win rooms by consistently turning seller feedback into something they can use, so sellers pull you in rather than field marketing pushing in.

• Keep messaging, competitive positioning, and deal materials current as what you hear in deals and at events changes them.

What you'll bring

• 5+ years in inbound product marketing, sales, partner, customer marketing, or growth roles for a technical B2B product, ideally security or identity, with real time spent in front of customers, not just producing material for others to deliver.

• Track record owning a pipeline, bookings, or conversion number tied to direct field engagement.

• Comfort shaping positioning and messaging based on live customer signal, and comfort running a room: win rooms, deal strategy sessions, or executive briefings, at any audience size.

• Comfort analyzing deal and pipeline data to find the root cause of a stall, and turning that into a concrete recommendation.

• Willingness to travel regularly for in-person events and customer engagements.

• Judgment to build trust with sellers and account teams by consistently acting on their feedback, not just collecting it.

title: Growth Lead, Accounts
description:
ABOUT MIDDESK:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

The Role

Enterprise go to market is consolidating around precision, and AI is accelerating that shift. Signal and intent data, automated research, and agentic outreach tooling are making it possible to build a real system around a defined set of accounts instead of running broader campaigns at more names, and the companies winning right now are the ones building that system first. This role owns that system at Middesk: the named enterprise and mid-market account list itself, the research and signal engine behind it, and every coordinated campaign, outbound, paid, SEO/AEO, and events, built around it. You will own the pipeline number this account list produces end to end, even though most of the people who execute against it, the AEs and SDRs, don't report to you. You will work closely with them, and you will set the standard, the research, and the operating rhythm the whole motion runs against.

Hybrid

We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role there is an expectation of 2- 3 days per week in our NYC or SF office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own Middesk's qualified new logo pipeline number across enterprise and mid-market named accounts, end to end

- Build and maintain a documented named account list by segment, with clear criteria, a re-audit cadence, and refresh as deals close

- Stand up account enrichment and research: AI-enabled signal and intent data, automated research, investor and network mapping, contact enrichment

- Build scalable, coordinated outreach systems across email, cold calling, LinkedIn, and every other channel that reaches these accounts

- Orchestrate ads, SEO/AEO, and targeted events around named accounts so every channel reinforces outreach rather than running in isolation

- Design AI-enabled, trigger based automated workflows, event and intent triggers, follow up cadences, paid ads tied to SDR outreach, so channels work together instead of as one off campaigns

- Write the coverage standard AEs and SDRs work against, and run the weekly rhythm that holds the team to it

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

- A strategic thinker who can see the whole account motion, the list, the research, the outreach, and the campaigns, and build one coordinated system rather than run a single channel of campaigns against the list

- A track record of personally owning a number end to end in a high-growth environment, whether that's sales, pipeline, marketing, or account management, including when the people who drive that number don't report to you

- A strong executor as well as a strategist. You will build the plan and also do real work yourself, the list, the research, the first campaigns

- Comfortable working directly with sales leaders and reps, and confident enough to hold a peer AE and SDR team to a standard you set, without managing them

- Comfortable using AI tools to build and scale research,

This role is responsible for leading a team of material planners, improving planning discipline, strengthening inventory performance, and ensuring product availability while balancing customer service, working capital, excess inventory, and scrap risk.
The Supply Chain Manager will partner closely with Operations, Procurement, Finance, Commercial, Manufacturing, Quality, suppliers, distributors, and other stakeholders to improve supply chain visibility, standardize processes, and drive stronger business outcomes.
The successful candidate will bring strong people leadership, analytical thinking, process improvement, and cross-functional partnership skills, with the ability to build structure and drive continuous improvement across the supply chain function.

• Leading and developing a team of material planners responsible for supply planning, inventory management, and product availability

• Providing clear direction, coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities to team members

• Establishing planning expectations, operating rhythms, and accountability across the material planning function

• Overseeing analysis of forecast projections, demand changes, inventory requirements, and product delivery performance

• Ensuring inventory levels support customer demand while minimizing backorders, excess inventory, obsolescence, and scrap risk

• Driving improvements in forecast accuracy, inventory health, service levels, and planning execution

• Reviewing supply and inventory data to identify risks, trends, constraints, and opportunities

• Leading cross-functional efforts to resolve shortages, capacity constraints, supplier issues, and other supply disruptions

• Partnering with Procurement, Operations, Manufacturing, Finance, Commercial, Quality, and other functions to align supply plans with business priorities

• Building and maintaining effective relationships with suppliers, distributors, and other external partners

• Supporting supplier performance discussions and identifying opportunities to improve supply continuity and reliability

• Establishing and improving standardized supply chain processes, tools, and performance metrics

• Supporting the development of stronger planning and inventory management capabilities across the Animal Safety organization

• Monitoring key supply chain metrics and using data to drive decisions and corrective actions

• Supporting new product introductions, product transitions, discontinuations, and lifecycle planning

• Leading or supporting supply chain improvement initiatives focused on planning, inventory optimization, customer service, cost, and operational efficiency

• Identifying supply chain risks and implementing mitigation strategies

• Improving communication and visibility across planning, procurement, operations, and commercial teams

• Providing recommendations to leadership regarding inventory, supply risk, service performance, and planning priorities

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

title: Account Director
description:
As an account director at Aite-Novarica Group, you will be supporting clients of Aite-Novarica Group’s insights and advisory team. The main objectives of the role are to ensure client satisfaction, engagement, and success; manage the onboarding process for new subscription clients; and provide continued, proactive support with a key focus on retaining existing clients and increasing renewal rates and revenue. The candidate in this role will also cross-sell additional subscription products as well as upsell additional advisory/consulting solutions within your client base.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

• Managing and renewing insights and advisory contracts across 50 enterprise accounts (potentially more or fewer based on existing relationship size)

• Revenue forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis

• Work with insights and advisory as well as business development teams to creatively present a unique onboarding experience for each new account, familiarizing the client with our product offerings

• Set up a regular method of engagement that works for each client to make sure they are making the most of the relationship while not putting the burden on the client. Kick-off, ad hoc, and quarterly update calls should be established within the usual cadence of calls.

• Work with Aite-Novarica administrative team to:

• Set up and manage all client contracts and designated users on Aite-Novarica Group production website

• Run and analyze client usage reports

• Work with insights and advisory team to facilitate client inquiries to the appropriate advisor and promote direct interaction when appropriate

• Alert clients to recently published and upcoming research that aligns with their licensed services

• Advise on research outside of licensed services

• Maintain and update client data (name, title, email) in CRM, including key/primary contacts and new users, and add them to the appropriate designated user lists

• Plan and participate on client calls and in meetings, take notes, and follow up on any action items

• Create and edit presentations, spreadsheets, reports, and meeting materials as needed

• Prepare for and participate in internal account management calls to apprise management of client status

The ideal candidate brings eight to 10 years of client services and B2B business development experience, ability to engage C-level and senior leadership within client organizations, track record of overachievement on goals or quotas, proficiency in MS Office and Salesforce.com, outstanding written and oral communication skills, and strong project management and organizational skills. Candidate must thrive in a fast-paced environment and be fluent in English. A bachelor’s degree is required. Experience in the financial services industry, research, or a subscription-based sales model is a plus.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Aite-Novarica Group will never contact you from any domain other than @aitegroup.com, @novarica.com or @aite-novarica.com.

Aite Group (eye-tay) is a leading independent research and advisory firm focused on business, technology and regulatory issues and their impact on the financial services industry.

Aite Group offers membership to its syndicated research, which includes unlimited access to its analysts. Aite Group also conducts custom consulting projects, including white papers, in-person strategy sessions and Webinars, competitive analysis, market entry strategy, vendor evaluations, qualitative and quantitative customer research.

Aite Group's team of experts cover the banking, payment, wealth management, retail securities, institutional securities, health insurance, life insurance and P&C verticals.

title: Science Writer
description:
Science Buzz is a pre-launch blog that's focused on making research in the physical sciences accessible to a general audience.

We're looking for contributors with subject matter expertise in Earth Science, Biology, Physics, Astronomy, and Chemistry (and their sub-disciplines) to produce high-quality posts on recent discoveries/research, as well as guides and outlining content for infographics.

About you:

• You're an expert in some scientific domain. That doesn't necessarily mean you have a Ph.D. or have worked in the field professionally; we're happy to hire passionate amateurs. It does mean that you're familiar with the leading academic journals in the subject and have the background knowledge to understand the significance of new research.
* You can write clearly about complex topics. This means you know the Jargon of the field, but can communicate what is essential without relying on it.
* You understand the elements of producing viral content and aren't averse to formulas when they work (e.g., listicles).

Pros of working with us:

• Get paid to learn and write about something you're genuinely interested in
* All work published under your byline
* Flexibility: we rarely have strict deadlines and are happy to work with people who aren't able to contribute regularly.

What we look for:

• Typical article length of 800 - 2,000 words. We're open to longer pieces but will typically solicit them from contributors who we've worked with previously.
* Coverage of a topic that hasn't been widely reported on other blogs or in the press.
* We want to cover research that has been published in the last year, though this is not a hard rule.
* Relevance: our goal is to make science engaging, the primary way to do that is by illustrating how it connects to the lives of our readers.

* A sense of humor or whimsy.

Rates: Our starting rate is $150 per published article. Ideally, we would like contributors who can write several articles per week but are open to working with talented writers who as well.

Note: Because of the volume of applications we receive, we aren't able to personally follow up with everyone, but we will be in touch within 48 hours if it seems like there's a good potential match.

If you have a specific story idea you would like to pitch: please include the working title, subject, and potential sources. While we will need to see a full draft before committing to publish a piece, you can pitch an idea get our impression of whether it's a fit for us.

title: Payroll and Accounts Payable Analyst
description:
Job title: Payroll and Accounts Payable Analyst
Job type: Full-time
Location: Remote (US only)
Job Summary:
We are looking for a Payroll & Accounts Payable Analyst to own the accurate and timely processing of employee payroll and vendor payments. You will sit at the heart of our finance operations - ensuring employees and vendors are paid correctly and on schedule, controls are followed, and payroll and A/P data reconcile cleanly to the general ledger.
Responsibilities:

• Own end-to-end payroll processing across all pay cycles, including new hires, terminations, status changes, bonuses, commissions, and off-cycle runs

• Calculate, reconcile, and remit payroll taxes, garnishments, benefits deductions, and 401(k) contributions, ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local regulations

• Manage the full accounts payable lifecycle, including invoice intake, GL coding, approval routing, and timely vendor payments via ACH, check, and wire

• Perform three-way matching of invoices to purchase orders and receipts, resolving discrepancies with vendors and internal stakeholders

• Maintain vendor master data, collect W-9s, and prepare and file annual 1099s

• Reconcile payroll and A/P subledgers to the general ledger and prepare related journal entries and accruals for month-end close

• Monitor A/P aging and payment terms to optimize cash flow and capture early-payment discounts

• Administer employee expense reimbursements and corporate card programs, ensuring policy compliance

• Respond to employee payroll inquiries and vendor payment questions with accuracy, professionalism, and discretion

• Support internal and external audits by preparing schedules, documentation, and reconciliations

• Maintain and strengthen internal controls across the payroll and A/P functions

• Identify and implement opportunities to automate and scale payroll and A/P workflows as the company grows

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• 2-4 years of hands-on payroll and/or accounts payable experience

• Working knowledge of payroll tax regulations and wage-and-hour compliance

• Solid understanding of A/P processes, GL coding, and accrual accounting fundamentals

• Hands-on experience with a payroll platform and an ERP/accounting system

• Strong command of Google Sheets and Excel

• High degree of accuracy and discretion when handling confidential payroll and financial data

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage recurring, non-negotiable deadlines

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Comfortable working independently in a fully remote, fast-paced startup environment

Preferred Qualifications:

• FPC or CPP certification, or progress toward a professional payroll or accounting certification

• Multi-state payroll experience

• Experience with 1099 and monthly/quarterly/year-end payroll tax reporting

• Exposure to AI tools or automated accounting and payroll workflows
